findings.exact_correction: Retain original request identity/digest and initial task records, validate separately current task state through independently proven marker/revision successor records. Support ordinary exact Tasker tracking and declared task-plan revision without rewriting original scope or resetting history/counters; reject unrelated task/spec/pointer drift. Add current controller and installed same-invocation positive/negative regression cases.
findings.observed_deficiency: Every scoped adapter rebinds original tasks.md hash to current bytes; standalone validator also demands original markers and full requested IDs equal currently unfinished tasks. Reproduction: original scope ready, one authorized checkbox completion then implementation-scope-required-source-binding-missing. Reconstructing scope would lose the frozen request/history, so ordinary completion prevents re-entry.
findings.violated_requirement: FR-039/FR-041/FR-042; T070 immutable original request plus same-invocation independently proven task tracking.
findings.current_observation: Legitimate marker and revision successor scope re-entry is ready, but validate_scoped_implementation_progress constructs route_payload without task_tracking_successors/trusted_requested_task_ids. Independent disposable reproduction with a valid revision+marker chain and real resolved prior source finding: plain progress ready, initial scoped binding ready, final scoped progress blocked/task-tracking-proof-required. Thus normal same-invocation continuation after Tasker tracking remains broken.

findings.exact_correction: Materialize every canonical positive/negative fixture with contained current files/digests and complete schema/proof, eliminate forbidden nulls from accepted cases, and dispatch each case through the matching real validator/owner operation asserting its declared result. Preserve invalid null fixtures as explicit negative cases.
findings.observed_deficiency: Canonical proposal-one-adjacent-edge is marked accepted but has empty snapshot/decision and recovery:null, so strict proposal validation rejects it. Accepted prepare/recovery/evidence examples lack current required proof and are not materialized/executed by the harness. Most cases are descriptive entries; tests generate independent minimal requests and only directly execute receipt cases. Thus accepted fixture labels do not establish valid contract cases.
findings.violated_requirement: T053 strict positive and negative contract fixtures before adapter; no forbidden null placeholders.
findings.current_observation: Raw duplicate-key input now reaches CLI and positive proposal no longer uses null recovery. However recovery-skips-required-start-edge is present only in the fixture and is not dispatched/asserted anywhere in tests. Its request-schema validator returns recovery, so semantic rejection requires the omitted owner/operation test. Accepted canonical packets are materialized for schema validators rather than complete owner-ready proof, and the every-canonical-positive/negative operation requirement remains incomplete.

findings.exact_correction: Exercise LC001-LC015 through actual installed FlowKit adapter and rendered production phase nodes with strict owner0.3 packet and source closure, including all preflights, missing/stale proofs, ordered three-edge recovery, partial outcomes and explicit verification return/defer. Preserve owner unit tests as complementary evidence and regenerate accurate current case results.

LC008 repeated owner helper calls do not prove bounded production graph recovery.

However LC negative/question/partial outcomes remain owner-test method reruns rather than exact production rendered paths. lifecycle-cases.json explicitly retains this full-matrix gap (validation_boundary, summary.separate_follow_up and production_graph_integration.limits). findings.exact_correction: Capture actual original source/finding baseline before effects; use actual independent review objects and implementation-progress-scoped after effects, retain original and next baseline digests, perform exact Tasker marker transitions in fixture, and run production-rendered preparation/source/re-entry ordering with history persisted before modeled dispatch. Regenerate SI evidence retaining failed variants and never grant post-discovered finding retrospective credit.
findings.observed_deficiency: Installed SI harness fabricates a finding:fixture-progress ID and current resolved list after the source-effect write, then calls route_scoped_implementation directly instead of implementation-progress-scoped with a frozen baseline and independent resolution proof. It also keeps original task markers while claiming preparation/completion outcomes. This bypasses automatic closure validation and fails to test legitimate task-marker successor re-entry, hiding F020-LIFECYCLE-CODE-001. Reported15cases prove route predicate shapes, not the required full installed closure path.
findings.violated_requirement: T072/T075 immutable substantive baseline, actual pre-dispatch history and generic prior/current progress validation.
findings.current_observation: New source effects use a frozen pre-effect finding baseline and the scoped progress adapter, and an independent marker successor fixture was added. But preexisting-attempt SI cases still build previous/current assessment IDs from expected fixture values then call route_scoped_implementation directly, bypassing implementation-progress-scoped. The SI matrix does not execute rendered production nodes; the ordinary marker/revision fixture is separate from post-source progress and missed reproduced 001. Completed task proof and history checks therefore do not fulfill the recorded full installed closure path.

findings.violated_requirement: FR-039/FR-041/FR-042; T070 preserve validated in-scope revision derivatives and exact current semantic/source binding.
findings.observed_deficiency: Revision successor replay validates approved_specification_sha256 only as digest syntax and compares semantic scope only to another stored validation_result value, without recomputing task_revision_scope_digest or binding approved spec to original/current scope. Independent reproduction changes approved spec to 9*64, both semantic/validation scope digests to 8*64, recomputes event digest, and validate_implementation_scope still returns ready and exposes T003 as derived. A self-consistent stored label/hash is accepted as prior valid review.
findings.exact_correction: At successor revalidation bind frozen approved specification to immutable request and current preflight, recompute the exact selected-target task revision scope digest and require semantic review/validation result to match it. Preserve legitimate historical successor replay with separately retained controller provenance; reject fabricated or mismatched scope/specification proofs. Add focused original and installed negative tests.

findings.violated_requirement: FR-041/FR-045; T070 current whole-task substantiated completion must reach scope complete safely.
findings.observed_deficiency: validate_scoped_implementation_progress has no allowed eligibility_request input and constructs final route_payload without one. route_scoped_implementation requires that exact current proof for every complete assessment. Independent reproduction with current original scope, real persisted source-attempt history, resolved original finding and plain progress ready/remaining_ids=[] returns scoped blocked/scoped-completion-proof-required. Thus no successful final source pass can return complete through the scoped progress adapter.
findings.exact_correction: Add and preserve a strictly current eligibility_request for complete outcomes, bind it to the same immutable scope/successor chain and validate all requested/derived tasks completed with full independent proofs; forward trusted subset and successor state consistently. Add positive final-completion and forged/stale/omitted whole-task proof regressions through the installed scoped progress command.
